chunks: And in the narration of ʿUmar ibn Yazīd, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
"If he has gone only a little distance, then let him return and perform the two rakʿahs, or let him instruct some of the people, and let him perform them on his behalf."

key_terms.فَلْيُصَلِّهِمَا: then let him perform the two rakʿahs
key_terms.قَلِيلًا: a short distance or only a little

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he forgets the two rakʿahs of tawaf and has already left?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgot the two rakʿahs connected to tawaf and then moved away. If he has only gone a short distance, he should return and perform them; otherwise, someone else may perform them on his behalf.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: In a narration from Umar ibn Yazid, from Abu Abdullah (as):
"If he has only gone a short distance, let him return and perform the two Rak'ahs (units of prayer). Alternatively, he may ask someone else to perform them on his behalf."
